chunks.text: Day three! And yeah... you asked for a new voice. Here it is.
You couldn't pick speed or shooting... so one of you said: do both.
The rules. Every time the ball hits the ground, I run a full lap. And when I shoot... the ball can't bounce. Not before. Not after.
Round one. Juggling. One... two... three... dropped it. Lap.
Again. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven... dropped it. Another lap.
By the tenth lap my legs were jelly. But I hit twelve juggles in a row.
Round two. Volleys. No bounce allowed. First shot... over the fence. Second... off the post. Third... top bin!
Twenty shots. Seven goals. Fourteen laps.
Then the street kids came back. And this time... I nutmegged one of them. They actually let me play.
Okay... let's check the card. Speed: fifteen to twenty. Shooting: twelve to nineteen. Overall... seventeen. Let's go!
Seventeen. Still a long way from seventy-five. So what's next?

chunks.title: TRYOUT
chunks.text: Option A: I join a Sunday league tryout... and play a real match.

chunks.title: DRIBBLING
chunks.text: Option B: I keep training with the street kids... and learn to dribble.
Got a crazy workout like today's? Drop it in the comments. Comment A or B... that's Day four.
